en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy fishing harbor filled with small sailing and row boats tied to wooden posts, with larger masted ships and a townscape in the background. In the foreground several people stand by a beached boat. The title in red German script at the top identifies the scene as the fishing‑boat harbor on the north side of Kolberg. A small blank rectangular area is reserved for writing, and a red imprint at the bottom left credits the publisher.
